text_block_list.text:
The waiting room is quiet as Фудзи Кисэки
and I sit,
waiting for the Satsuki Sho to
begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hi, Fuji! Sorry to call you right before
your race!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You're totally fine. Is something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Well, the truth is, everyone came
to watch
you run today!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
We wanted to make sure our cheers
reached you,
so we all came! Good luck!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You've got this, Fuji! ☆ We can't wait to
see the
show!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Totally! No one stands a chance against
you!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Smiling faces and waving hands fill the
screen of
Fuji Kiseki's phone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you guys... This is such an amazing
surprise!
I never would have imagined
this!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you so much, my ponies.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure not to disappoint you in
today's
race. I am your dorm leader,
after all!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Even through the screen, the cheers and
screams
from the stands are loud. The
curtains have risen
on the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
